blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Effective multi-agent collaboration requires agents to adapt task allocation as goals and responsibilities evolve. Prior task-allocation frameworks often assume static goals, full observability, or rely on large language models (LLMs) without explicit, verifiable beliefs about task allocation or intent. These assumptions limit their applicability to real-world collaboration, where agents often lack full information about each other's actions, progress, or local environment. To support dynamic task allocation under partial observability, we introduce a communication-augmented Bayesian task-allocation framework. Our agent uses dialogue to reduce uncertainty about the environment and collaborators, while keeping decisions grounded in explicit probabilistic beliefs. We evaluate our framework in an Overcooked domain extended with dynamically arriving tasks under both full and partial object-space observability. Our communication agent consistently outperforms a vanilla LLM agent in both settings. Additionally, our framework performs comparably to a non-communicating task-allocation baseline under full observability, but substantially outperforms it under partial observability as task complexity increases by an average speed up of 0.585 and completes on average 18 timesteps faster. These results indicate that our agent is more efficient in dynamic task allocation than baselines in partially observable environments, and that communication is important as available information decreases.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Humans often collaborate in environments where goals, responsibilities, and progress constantly evolve, from cooking in a kitchen to performing symphonies [ 12 ] .
In these settings, collaborators must continually coordinate how duties are distributed and updated over time, a process known as dynamic task allocation .
In a busy kitchen, for example, cooks redistribute tasks such as preparation, cooking, plating, and serving based on workload and individual progress.
Dialog is one of the most common modalities for this coordination, enabling collaborators to communicate progress, negotiate responsibilities, and maintain a shared understanding of the task [ 8 , 4 , 6 , 9 ] , as shown in Figure 1 .
Effective human-agent collaboration therefore requires artificial agents that can use dialog to perform dynamic task allocation, reasoning about collaborators’ goals, actions, and progress to adapt responsibilities as an interaction unfolds [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
人类往往在目标、责任和进步不断演变的环境中合作,从厨房做饭到交响曲[12]。
在这些环境下,合作者必须不断协调责任的分配和更新,这一过程被称为动态任务分配。
例如,在一个繁忙的厨房里,厨师根据工作量和个人进展重新分配诸如准备、烹饪、电镀等任务。
如图1所示,对话是这种协调的最常见方式之一,使合作者能够交流进展、谈判责任并保持对任务的共识[8、4、6、9]。
因此,有效的人与代理人合作需要人工代理人,他们可以利用对话来进行动态的任务分配,推理合作者的目标、行动和进步,以便在互动过程中调整责任[13]。

blocks.en:
Prior work has used reinforcement learning and large language models (LLMs) to develop collaborative agents [ 5 , 21 , 10 , 19 ] .
However, many approaches assume static goals, prior knowledge about collaborators, and full observability [ 23 , 24 ] , limiting their applicability to settings where goals and responsibilities constantly change or the environment is only partially observable.
Such settings are common in real-world collaboration, where agents must reason under uncertainty about both the task and their collaborators.

这种环境在现实世界合作中很常见,在现实世界中,代理人必须在任务及其合作者的不确定性下提出理由。

blocks.en:
We address this challenge by developing an agent that maintains belief states over the environment and collaborators, enabling dynamic task allocation under partial observability, evolving tasks, and no prior knowledge of partners.
Building on Wu et al. [23] , our agent reasons about unobserved objects, updates task allocations from new evidence, and exchanges task-relevant information beyond direct observation with dialog.
Together, these mechanisms support long-horizon collaborative planning under uncertainty about both the environment and other agents’ behavior.

在吴等[23]的基础上,我们代理人对不可观察物体的理由,从新的证据中更新任务分配,并与对话交换与任务有关的信息。
这些机制共同支持在环境和其他行为者行为不确定的情况下进行长期协作规划。

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Multi-Agent Planning
blocks.zh: II-A 多代理规划

blocks.en:
Significant work in multi-agent planning has studied how agents coordinate task allocation with collaborators [ 18 , 2 , 16 ] .
Ad hoc teamwork studies the setting where agents need to coordinate with previously unseen teammates without prior agreement on a joint policy [ 18 , 2 , 16 ] . Wu et al. [23] introduce Bayesian Delegation to update task allocations in collaboration, which decomposes tasks into subtasks and uses inverse planning to infer a collaborator’s latent subtask allocation. Ying et al. [24] extend this line to partially observable settings by combining recursive Theory of Mind reasoning with communication for human-agent collaboration.
However, these prior methods assume fixed goal specifications [ 18 , 2 , 16 , 24 , 23 ] and do not work when goals are continually evolving.
In contrast, our agent performs dynamic task allocation through natural-language dialog in partially observable environments without prior knowledge of the collaborator’s behavior.
blocks.zh:
在多代理人规划方面的重要工作已研究了代理人如何与协作者协调任务分配[18、2、16]。
特别团队合作研究代理人需要与先前未见的队友协调而事先未就联合政策达成协议的环境[18、2、16]。 吴等. [23] 引入贝叶斯代表团,以合作更新任务分配,将任务分解为子任务,并使用反向规划来推断合作者的潜在子任务分配. 扬等. [24] 将这条线扩展至部分可观察到的设置,将"心灵推理"的递归理论与人类与代理人协作的交流相结合.
然而,这些先前的方法假定了固定目标规格[18、2、16、24、23],并且在目标不断演变时不起作用。
反之,我们的代理人在部分可观察环境中通过自然语言对话进行动态任务分配,而事先对合作者的行为一无所知。

blocks.en: II-B Human-Agent Dialogue
blocks.zh: II-B 人与物对话

blocks.en:
Researchers have long studied how to build collaborative agents that use dialogue [ 25 , 24 , 10 , 20 , 7 , 15 ] . Chai et al. [3] describe dialogue as a form of interaction through which humans communicate task-relevant knowledge to embodied agents.
Prior works also develop agents that actively ask for help when the agent is stuck [ 20 ] or uncertain about the task [ 15 , 7 ] .
Beyond help-seeking, recent work has incorporated dialogue into collaborative task reasoning, using language models to infer collaborators’ mental states or generate coordinated actions [ 25 , 24 , 10 ] .
In our setting, dialogue is used to communicate task-relevant information and provide evidence for deciding future actions.
blocks.zh:
研究人员长期研究如何建立使用对话的合作代理人[25、24、10、20、7、15]。 柴来等. [3] 将对话描述为一种互动形式,人类通过这种形式将与任务相关的知识传递给被体现的代理人.
前作还开发出当代理被卡住[20]或任务不确定[15,7]时积极请求帮助的代理.
除了寻求帮助之外,最近的工作将对话纳入了合作任务推理,利用语言模型推断合作者的精神状态或产生协调行动[25、24、10]。
在我们的环境下,对话被用来传递与任务有关的信息,并为决定未来行动提供证据。

blocks.en: II-C LLM-based Planning
blocks.zh: II-C LLM 规划

blocks.en:
LLMs have been increasingly studied for generating plans and coordinating agents [ 26 , 11 , 1 ] . Liu et al. [10] propose an LLM-based hierarchical language agent for real-time human-AI coordination by combining language-based intention reasoning with reactive execution. Sun et al. [19] show that LLM agents struggle with active collaboration and continuous adaptation by introducing a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based multi-agent systems on collaborative tasks.
Furthermore, Valmeekam et al. [22] show that LLMs perform poorly as autonomous long-horizon planners, but can provide useful heuristic guidance for other planners.
In our approach, the LLM is used to interpret dialogue as task-relevant evidence for an explicit multi-agent planning procedure.
blocks.zh:
制定计划和协调机构时越来越多地研究法学硕士课程[26、11、1]。 刘等. [10]提出基于LLM的分级语言代理,通过将基于语言的意向推理与被动执行相结合,进行实时人类-AI协调. 孙等. [19] 显示LLM代理在积极协作和持续适应中挣扎,引入了对基于LLM的多代理系统进行协作任务评价的基准.
此外,Valmeekam等人也指出,“在战争期间,政府必须采取措施,防止恐怖主义。 [22] 显示LLMs作为自主长视距规划者的表现不佳,但可以为其他规划者提供有益的heuristic指导.
在我们的方法中,LLM被用来解释对话是明确多代理规划程序与任务相关的证据。

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: IV-A Domain
blocks.zh: 四-A 领域

blocks.en:
We extend the Overcooked environment introduced by Wu et al. [23] with dynamic goal setting, where tasks are revealed incrementally during execution rather than fixed at the start.
We also introduce partially observable settings in which collaborators’ actions or local environments are not accessible to the agent.
This environment allows us to test agents’ reasoning and communication abilities on dynamic goals under different levels of uncertainty.
Additional details can be found in Appdx. Extended Results .
blocks.zh:
我们扩展了由吴等介绍的"超熟"环境. [23] 具有动态目标设定,其中任务在执行过程中逐渐被揭示,而不是在开始时被固定.
我们还引入了合作者的行动或当地环境无法进入的部分可观察环境。
这种环境使我们能够测试代理人在不同不确定程度下对动态目标的推理和沟通能力。

blocks.en: IV-B Baselines
blocks.zh: 四-B 基线

blocks.en: We compare against baselines suited to each observability setting. Under full observability, we adapt the task-allocation algorithm of Wu et al. [23] to support dynamic task arrivals, modifying it to replan as the task queue changes over an episode. Under partial observability, a setting we introduce for this domain, we use an ablation of our own method with communication removed, isolating the contribution of explicit communication when agents lack full environmental knowledge. In both settings we also compare against a vanilla LLM agent, following the LLM-based agents benchmarked by Sun et al. [19] , which receives the same observability-appropriate information but selects actions directly, without the additional mechanisms in our methodology.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了适合每个可观察性设定的基线。 在完全可观察性下,调整了吴等的任务分配算法. [23] 支持动态任务到达,修改后随着任务队列相对于一集的变化进行再规划. 在部分可观察性 -- -- 我们为这个领域引入的一种环境 -- -- 下,我们使用我们自己的方法去除通讯,在代理人缺乏充分环境知识时隔离明确通讯的贡献。 在这两种情况下,我们也比较了香草LLM剂,遵循了由Sun等人制定的以LLM为基础的剂。 [19],它收到同样的可观察性适当信息,但直接选择行动,没有我们的方法中的额外机制.

blocks.en: IV-D Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 四-D 实验结果

blocks.en: We evaluate full and partial observability separately, varying task queue length and layout within each setting; full experimental parameters are reported in Appendix Extended Results .
blocks.zh: 我们分别评估完全和部分可观察性、不同任务队列长度和布局;在附录扩展结果中报告全部实验参数。

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Full Observability
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 完全可观察性

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 3(a) , the communication agent consistently outperforms the vanilla LLM agent across both layouts, with the largest speedups at the queue length of one and diminishing gains as queue length increases.
As shown in Fig. 3(b) , our agent is comparable to the non-communicative baseline across most conditions.
Because both agents observe the full object space, the non-communication agent already has access to much of the information communication would otherwise convey, limiting its added benefit.
blocks.zh:
如图3(a)所示,通信代理在两种布局上始终超过香草LLM代理,在队列长度为一时的最大速度,并随着队列长度的增加而逐渐减少增益.
如图3(b)所示,我们的代理人与大多数情况下的非传染性疾病基线相当。
由于这两种物剂都观测到整个物体空间,因此非通信物剂已经可以接触许多否则会传递的信息通信,从而限制了其附加的好处.

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Partial Observability
blocks.zh: IV-D 2 部分可观察性

blocks.en:
The communication agent consistently outperforms the vanilla LLM agent, with gains again largest at a queue length of one (Fig. 4(a) ).
However, communication now yields a clear advantage over the non-communication baseline (Fig. 4(b) ).
This advantage generally grows with queue length and is most pronounced in the asymmetric layout at a queue length of three.
With less available knowledge, communication is more important to close the information gap between the agents.
blocks.zh:
通信代理的性能一直高于香草LLM代理的性能,在队列长度为一(图4(a))时的增益再次最大.
然而,与非通信基线相比,通信现在具有明显的优势(图4(b))。
这种优势一般会随队列长度而增长,在队列长度为3的不对称布局中最为突出.
在知识较少的情况下,沟通对于弥合各机构之间的信息差距更为重要。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our results show that explicit task allocation and communication provide structure that a vanilla LLM agent lacks: the LLM baseline fails to complete any configuration, while our agent succeeds across observability settings.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,明确的任务分配和通信提供了一个香草LLM代理缺乏的结构:LLM基线无法完成任何配置,而我们的代理则通过可观察性设置成功.

blocks.en:
The value of communication depends on observability.
Under full observability, our agent performs similarly to the non-communication baseline because agents can infer collaborators’ tasks from visible actions.
Under partial observability, communication becomes increasingly important, especially as queue length grows, because actions alone no longer reveal enough about collaborators’ tasks or progress.
blocks.zh:
通信的价值取决于可观察性.
在完全可观察的情况下,我们的代理人履行与非通信基线类似的职能,因为代理人可以从明显的行动中推断出合作者的任务。
在局部的可观察性下,沟通变得日益重要,特别是随着排队时间的延长,因为单靠行动就不再足以揭示合作者的任务或进展。

blocks.en: VI Limitations
blocks.zh: 六. 限制

blocks.en:
Our work has two main limitations.
First, our communication mechanism is deliberately narrow: utterances convey task-allocation intent but not richer beliefs, questions, negotiation, or repair, and the entropy-based speaking trigger may not reflect what a collaborator already knows.
Second, our experiments are limited in scale, with one environment family, two layouts, short task queues, two baselines, and six runs per configuration, and they assume known task types, a fixed agent set, and reliable cost-free communication.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作有两个主要的局限性。
首先,我们的交流机制是刻意缩小的:言语传达的是任务分配的意图,但不传达更丰富的信念、问题、谈判或修复,而以肽为基础的演讲触发器可能不能反映合作者已经知道的情况。
其次,我们的实验规模有限,有1个环境家族,2个布局,短任务排队,2个基线,每个配置6个跑步,它们承担已知的任务类型,固定的代理集,可靠的免费通信.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce a Bayesian task allocation algorithm for dynamically arriving tasks and partial object-space observability, using language as probabilistic evidence within an explicit inference procedure.
Our results show that this framework enables stronger dynamic task allocation under partial observability than the baselines, and that communication becomes more important as available information decreases.
blocks.zh:
我们采用了巴耶斯任务分配算法,用于动态到达任务和部分对象空间可观察性,在明确的推论程序内将语言作为概率证据.
我们的结果表明,这一框架使得在部分可观察性下更有力地进行动态任务分配,而且随着现有信息的减少,信息通报变得更加重要。

blocks.en: The observation likelihood is grounded in the deterministic dynamics of the environment: since only agent j j can explain changes inconsistent with agent i i ’s own action, each observed state transition provides evidence about the hidden environment. blocks.en: While environmental evidence provides information about actions that have already occurred, communication provides information about actions an agent intends to perform in the future. Because completing a task requires the necessary prerequisite objects, an utterance describing a task allocation implicitly conveys information about the hidden environment: for example, if agent j j communicates that it will independently prepare a dish, agent i i can infer that the ingredients, action objects, and dispensers required for that task are available within S j S^{j} .

blocks.en: Agents are tasked with completing N N tasks within a horizon of t max t_{\max} timesteps. Tasks are revealed incrementally, and agents do not know the complete task set in advance, although they know the set of possible task types. At each timestep, a new task is revealed with probability r r until all N N tasks have been revealed. To maintain continuous availability of work, at least one task remains active in the task queue until all tasks have been completed.
